hints.title: Local Delta Updates
hints.text: Modifying nums[idx] only affects adjacent relationships with its left neighbor (idx - 1) and right neighbor (idx + 1).

hints.title: Remove Old Matches
hints.text: Before painting nums[idx], decrement the match counter if it currently matches a non-zero colored neighbor.

hints.title: Add New Matches
hints.text: After updating nums[idx] with the new color, increment the counter if it matches a non-zero colored neighbor.

hints.title: Adjacent Match Counter Implementation

complexity.notes: Each query performs O(1) neighbor boundary checks.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning full array after each query requires O(q * n) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Maintains running matching counter using O(1) delta checks per query.
